description: The Open WebUI surface of the node (peer PLAN Step 5 DoD 1): plan, build, vault, the node orchestrator and MASTERSPIKE are selectable as models, each bound to the agent that owns it. This file is the committed, versioned declaration — Open WebUI panel state is a database click and must never be the source of truth, because a redeploy must not lose the surface. Read by the dispatch bridge (`/v1/models`) and by peer-node/tests/test_webui_surface.py, which fails the build if the declared surface and the bridge disagree.

selectable.label: Plan (node agent)
selectable.voice: compile a plan, then hand off

selectable.label: MASTERSPIKE (llm-wiki format)
selectable.voice: carry the Master role and the llm-wiki knowledge format
selectable.why: a format, never a capability: authority is Ed25519 in the Master, not a prompt (peer PLAN Step 7 DoD 4)

why_these_agents: plan and build are opencode built-ins (present in any opencode node); `vault` and `sparknet-node` are the node's own agent papers, bundled with the role; `masterspike` is the Step 7 format carrier — a model, selectable like the agents, that holds no signing capability (peer PLAN Step 7 DoD 4). Each id here is a role the node births, not a model the bridge invents — the bridge still discovers on-disk pods (`.opencode/agents/*.md`, `agents/*/`) as its second, unselectable tier.

local_models.label: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B Q4_K_M (teacher)
local_models.why: The live teacher winner on agx64: 22.22 tok/s, 21.21 GiB, 100% on the fixed suite (Q4_K_M, Ollama). Selectable, not the default; llama3.2 remains the fallback.
